name: ZubaEagermon
main_effect: [On Play] By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon that's black or has the [Legend-Arms] trait as its bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
source_effect: [When Attacking] If you have a Digimon that's black or has the [Legend-Arms] trait in play, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
